decisions.rule: The four dm26sd1-o001STAR prints are canonical dmrp21-1A, 「正義星帝」 ＜ライオネル.Star＞. Preserve its literal angle suffix when stripping real HTML tags. This corrects one official template row without rewriting saved personal decks. The unrelated basic Justice card is not part of this official list.

Lionel Star draws one, then may put a light seed from hand. Each live source separately observes own seeds entering and may deploy a cost-six-or-lower evolution once per turn. Skipping does not consume its use. Putting a seed is distinct from using it, so Giant Orb use lock does not prohibit this put; entry replacements still apply.

Star evolution is a mandatory leave replacement: move only the top card and reconstruct the remainder with the same creature state, effects and valid equipment. Competing replacements are chosen once. A full exchange cannot proceed if underlying cards would remain (QA39567/41430). Reconstructing to a seed detaches equipment. The Star leave replacement still applies when abilities are ignored (QA39833); it is distinct from ignored entry abilities and Powered Breaker.

S-MAX needs no evolution base, counts as evolution for immediate attacks and non-evolution selectors, and keeps only one S-MAX immediately even if its abilities are ignored (QA41094/41554/41087/47923). Preserve an interrupted decision through JSON while resolving this rule.

The loss replacement must discard one exact-name card from hand or destroy the source if possible; a mandatory available replacement cannot be declined. A replacement destruction cannot itself be replaced again. Each selected break adds a shield before protection can prevent that break (QA41187). At attack end, ten shields allow the special win.

Powered Breaker is one plus floor(current power / 6000). Johnny counts each other Joker/Rex element once. Arc buffs other Rex creatures. External power bonuses remain when recipient abilities are ignored; Johnny own scaling and Powered Breaker do not.

Each player keeps at most one creature OR seed from the combined eligible set, choosing active player first. Shuffle the others together, then add shields for physical cards actually put into that player library, including only the Star top when its replacement applies. Independent gears remain; EX-life replacement which moves no card into the deck adds no shield.

Peace chooses two modes, allowing repeats, and completes each mode before choosing the next. Its Revolution2 trigger checks shield count after the entire break. Rune may decline milling and still use a cost-four-or-lower noncreature face from grave, and untaps itself after moving from hand to mana.

Slotton deploys a light evolution costing at most seven, including S-MAX, then grants snapshot Blocker until the next own start. AQ counts water creatures/seeds and may use a seed or spell costing at most five. Korail draws for the chosen owner even if the selected card cannot leave. Geraccho draws, then the opponent chooses their own untapped creature to tap.
Shuffle only the selected player grave into the bottom, preserving the prior library prefix, then draw two for the caster. The resolving spell joins the grave afterward.
Arc accepts Rex/light/fire bases, buffs other Rex creatures, locks non-light spells and taps only the first opposing actual creature entry per turn.
